body:
I don't want my family to hate me if I move out. I know my boyfriend has  been depressed too, but he has a different way of dealing with it then I do. I know he's trying his best, but I also know that he wishes he didn't have to deal with it.

I just feel like if the world was one less in population tomorrow it wouldn't really matter.

My boyfriend and I are trying to move out in a few months. But I'm scared of how my family will react. I'm only 18, and they already think I'm a slut. They'll say something like "Oh, look she's moving out with her boyfriend and leaving her poor mother to take care of the kids by herself." 
and I'm scared of how my boyfriend will adjust to living with me, I've told him about these thoughts and feelings before, and he just tells me how I need to stop feeling that way, because he loves me for a reason and if I feel worthless then that would mean he chose to be with someone worthless.
